news_list.title: Japan's Tankan Large Manufacturing Index rises to 22 in Q2 vs. 16 expected | FXStreet
news_list.summary:
The Bank of Japan's (BoJ) Tankan survey of business sentiment surged significantly past market forecasts in the manufacturing sector. Japan's Tankan Large Manufacturing Index climbed to 22 in the second quarter (Q2) from 17 in the previous reading, stronger than the market expectation of 16.

Meanwhile, Japan's Tankan Non-Manufacturing Index rose to 37 in Q2, versus 36 prior. This figure came in above the market consensus of 35.

news_list.title: Paraguay says open to trade with China if Taiwan ties untouched
news_list.summary:
Mercosur leaders are launching trade talks with Japan and considering talks with China, while Paraguay remains the only Mercosur member not diplomatically linked to China.

LUQUE, Paraguay - Paraguay is open to trade with China as long as it does not have to sever ties with Taiwan, its foreign minister said on June 30.

Leaders of the South American Mercosur bloc are meeting in Paraguay to launch trade negotiations with Japan following the sealing of a deal with the European Union in January.

During the summit, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva suggested that talks with China were also in the pipeline.

Paraguay, Taiwan's lone South American ally, is the only Mercosur member that does not maintain diplomatic relations with the Asian giant.

"Paraguay does not refuse to establish trade relations with China, as long as there are no conditions regarding the diplomatic relationship that Paraguay has and maintains with Taiwan," Foreign Minister Ruben Ramirez said at the meeting on the outskirts of Asuncion.

"If those are the conditions, we have no restrictions," Ramirez said.

Taipei has only 12 diplomatic allies after Beijing - which claims Taiwan is part of its territory - systematically poached the others in a bid to isolate the self-governed island.

China has urged Paraguay "make the right choice" and cut ties with Taiwan.

The summit in Asuncion also saw Paraguayan President Santiago Pena criticise the "bitter taste" left by the EU-Mercosur deal.

Twenty-five years in the making, the agreement created one of the world's biggest free-trade zones.

"The playing field is not level for everyone," Pena said, suggesting that his country felt slighted by the accord's export quotas, which it believes favors other members of the bloc.

Under the deal, the European Union offers Mercosur import quotas with tariff benefits, leaving the bloc to decide how to distribute them among its partners.

Pena has called for quotas to be shared equally between Mercosur's partners before the EU ratifies the deal, calling it a "question of justice."

"If Mercosur wants to be credible outwardly, it first has to be fair inwardly," he added.

Brazil's Luiz Inacio Lula Da Silva, Bolivia's Rodrigo Paz and Uruguay's Yamandu Orsi attended the meeting, as did leaders of associate countries Chile and Ecuador.

Argentine President Javier Milei, whose country also belongs to the bloc, cancelled his attendance as he was grappling with the domestic fallout of his top governmental aide's resignation. AFP

news_list.title: Recce Pharmaceuticals bolsters cash position with A$3.67 million tax refund ahead of Phase 3 milestones
news_list.summary:
Recce Pharmaceuticals Ltd (ASX:RCE, OTC:RECEF) has strengthened its balance sheet with the receipt of a A$3.67 million income tax refund from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO), adding further non-dilutive funding as the company advances its synthetic anti-infective pipeline toward key Phase 3 clinical milestones.

The refund relates to the financial year ended June 30, 2025, and comprises A$3.57 million in overseas research and development expenditure, plus A$95,826 in interest paid by the ATO.

The receipt lifts Recce's pro-forma cash position to about A$33.1 million, up from the previously stated A$29.5 million, leaving the company well placed to progress upcoming clinical, regulatory and commercial licensing activities.

Cash boost follows A$4 million placement

The tax refund complements Recce's recently completed A$4 million placement to institutional, sophisticated and professional investors.

The placement was priced at A$0.40 per share and involved the issue of 10 million new fully paid ordinary shares.

Recce is also preparing to open a share purchase plan (SPP) to eligible shareholders on July 6, 2026, allowing participants to subscribe for up to A$30,000 worth of new shares on the same terms as the placement.

The SPP is targeting up to a further A$4 million before costs, potentially taking total proceeds from the equity raising to A$8 million.

Funding directed to licensing and clinical trials

Funds from the placement and SPP will support commercial licensing activity, clinical trials and regulatory-enabling work across Recce's anti-infective pipeline.

The company has allocated A$3.2 million toward strengthening its position for commercial licensing discussions with a leading Middle Eastern pharmaceutical company, including workstreams designed to support a potential commercial agreement.

A further A$2 million has been set aside for clinical trials targeting areas of significant unmet medical need, including Recce's Phase 3 diabetic foot infections (DFI) registrational topical clinical trial in Indonesia and a Phase 3 DFI registrational topical clinical trial in Australia for the US Food and Drug Administration.

Funding will also support continuation of the US Department of War Burn Wound Program.

Another A$2 million is allocated to activities enabling Investigational New Drug applications to the FDA and Indonesia's BPOM, while A$800,000 will be used for general working capital and offer costs.

Further R&D rebate expected

Recce expects to receive further non-dilutive funding, including an R&D Tax Incentive rebate from the ATO for the financial year ending June 30, 2026, of about A$7.5 million.

This anticipated rebate, together with current cash reserves and capital raising proceeds, is expected to support the company as it moves toward interim clinical data readouts and broader commercialisation opportunities.

Recce CEO James Graham said the capital raising came at an important stage for the company.

"The capital raising comes at an exciting time for the Recce business, having recently signed a non-binding term sheet with a leading Middle Eastern Pharmaceuticals Company and ahead of interim data readouts in Indonesia which is a positive step towards the potential commercialisation of R327G," Graham said.

news_list.title: Savings Banks Flood Market With 4% Deposit Products Amid Rate Competition
news_list.summary:
LegoLand Crisis Concerns Resurface as Deposit Costs Threaten Profitability

Savings banks have reignited interest rate competition by flooding the market with fixed-term deposit products offering annual interest rates in the 4% range. While this is a desperate measure to capture funds, money move, flowing into the stock market, concerns are emerging that the 2022 "LegoLand crisis," which caused massive deficits for savings banks due to increased funding costs, could recur.

According to the Korea Federation of Savings Banks' consumer portal product disclosure on July 1, the average interest rate for one-year fixed-term deposits at 79 units of savings banks nationwide was recorded at an annual 3.79%. Compared to June 17, when the first annual 4.5% interest rate product appeared this year (average rate 3.55%), the rate has risen by 0.24 percentage points.

Competition to attract deposit products is also intense. Fixed-term deposit products with annual interest rates in the 4% range, which were nonexistent just a month ago, have surged to 105 units. A total of 32 savings banks are offering annual interest rates in the 4% range. Currently, savings banks providing annual interest rates of 4.5% or higher based on the base rate include OSB Savings Bank (2 units), OK Savings Bank (1 unit), and Acuon Savings Bank (1 unit), among others.

Signs of market overheating are also emerging. On June 18, Raon Savings Bank launched a deposit product with an annual 4.6% interest rate but halted sales just one day later as subscribers flooded in.

There are also concerns that this interest rate competition could repeat the nightmare of the LegoLand crisis. In 2022, following the LegoLand crisis, savings banks raised deposit rates by offering special sales of products with interest rates in the 6% range to secure liquidity. Subsequently, as maturities concentrated, they failed to withstand the pressure of interest costs and suffered massive deficits and deteriorated soundness as aftereffects.

This interest rate hike competition also poses a significant risk of worsening the profit structure of savings banks. This is because, due to recent government loan regulations, application of a 50% DSR for the secondary financial sector, etc., savings banks find it difficult to generate profits through loans even when they gather funds through deposits. In particular, if the base interest rate rises in the second half of the year, the cost burden from deposit competition is expected to increase further.

ai_analysis.full_text:
【今日結論】
今日台股盤勢呈現「跳空高開後的震盪格局」，強勢看多，但需嚴防外資在開盤後的短線獲利回吐賣壓。建議操作以「強者恆強」為主軸，利用開盤跳空帶來的溢價進行持股汰弱留強，避免擴大槓桿追價。
【新聞驅動】
美股費半大漲 3.92% 與台積電 ADR 暴漲 4.94% 構成今日最強的驅動引擎，AI 供應鏈與權值股的估值修正行情進入爆發期。全球市場雖有鎢原料短缺與製造業裁員的結構性隱憂，但在資金強勢進場的情緒帶動下，這些長期風險暫被市場忽略，資金正瘋狂回補科技權值股。
【國際與台股】
受美股科技股領漲帶動，台股大盤面臨極大的向上跳空壓力，但需警惕技術面出現的「流動性背離」，即 QQQ-XLP 顯示機構大戶在追價的同時，仍保留了消費必需品防禦資產。雖然台股加權指數來到 46,125 點的高位且市場情緒轉向「貪婪」，但外資期貨連續四日的空單留倉與 1.34 的 PC Ratio 指出，盤中極可能面臨長黑回測，切勿忽視盤中殺尾盤的賣壓。
【KOL與情緒】
當前散戶情緒已從單一的 AI 題材擴散至先進封裝與存股防禦，這代表市場投機動能已來到過度集中的階段。散戶對於 0056 與 006208 等 ETF 的高熱度，預示著市場已經進入「情緒過熱」的後段，若電子零組件族群無法在開盤後守住買氣，高檔套牢壓力將迅速湧現。
【操作含意】
今日不宜盲目追價，操作策略應由「預測反轉」轉為「應對震盪」，若大盤無法在 46,000 點以上維持爆量換手，應果斷將倉位收斂至具備定價權的權值股。請密切監控台幣匯率變動，若盤中匯率轉弱，將是外資結束短線套利、實質轉為賣超的關鍵訊號，屆時務必執行嚴格的停利策略。
